info.title: Self Assessment Test Support (MTD)

post.description:
This endpoint enables you to create a test business for use within the Sandbox environment.

Customers may have multiple Self-Employment businesses, but only one of each Property business is allowed. 
MTD supports only one accounting period per year so this must be a full tax year period, for example April 6th to April 5th. 
Test businesses are automatically purged from the database 7 days after creation.

tradingType.description:
The type of trading carried out by the business.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

tradingName.description:
The trading name of the business.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

taxYear1.description: First tax year for the income source.

latencyIndicator1.description: Self assessment submission frequency ('A' - Annual, 'Q' - Quarterly).

taxYear2.description: Second tax year for the income source.

commencementDate.description: Business start date, must be in the past. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

cessationDate.description: Business cessation date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

businessAddressLineTwo.description:
Second line of the business address.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Third line of the business address.

Forbidden for property businesses.

businessAddressLineFour.description:

Forbidden for property businesses.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses if businessAddressCountryCode "GB" is provided.

businessAddressCountryCode.description:
The two letter code for a country must adhere to ISO 3166.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

post.description:
This endpoint enables you to create and amend a test ITSA status for a specified customer for use within the sandbox environment. The ITSA status provided is used to validate periodic and annual submissions for the customer's income sources.

A National Insurance number and tax year must be provided.

Any test ITSA status is automatically purged from the database 7 days after its creation.

parameters.description: National Insurance number.
parameters.name: nino

parameters.description: The tax year to submit data for. The start year and end year must not span two tax years. No gaps are allowed - for example, 2023-25 is not valid. There is no minimum tax year.
parameters.name: taxYear

parameters.description: Specifies the response format and the version of the API to be used.
parameters.name: Accept

parameters.description: An OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token with the *write:self-assessment* scope.
parameters.name: Authorization

itsaStatusDetails.description: An array of ITSA status details for a specific National Insurance number and tax year.

submittedOn.description: The date the ITSA status was submitted, in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ

statusReason.description: The reason for the ITSA status.

businessIncome2YearsPrior.description:
The business income for 2 years prior to the specified taxYear.

For example, if the tax year requested is 2026-27, then 'businessIncome2YearsPrior' is for the 2024-25 tax year.

For Q4 check, the business income 1 year prior will be used.

delete.description:
This endpoint allows a developer to delete stateful test data supplied by them in the sandbox environment.
When the endpoint is called, all stateful test data stored against the vendor is deleted from the sandbox database.
Any stateful test data that has not been deleted by the developer is automatically deleted from database 7 days after 
its creation.

parameters.description:
National Insurance number, in the format `AA999999A`. 

If supplied, the endpoint deletes only stateful test data stored against the vendor that is associated with the specified National Insurance number.

post.description:
This endpoint enables you to set up a checkpoint for the stateful data in the sandbox environment for a given National Insurance number.

A National Insurance number must be provided.

You can reset the data back to the checkpoint created using the 'Restore to Checkpoint' endpoint.

**Note**: To prevent data loss or unexpected behaviour, the checkpoint restore should not be performed while any other stateful or checkpoint operations are in progress for the same National Insurance number.

delete.description:
This endpoint enables you to delete a checkpoint created in the sandbox, specified with a ‘checkpointId’.

Any checkpoint that is not deleted is automatically removed from the database 7 days after its creation.

Checkpoints can only be deleted with this endpoint. Deleting data with the Delete Stateful Test Data endpoint will not delete checkpoints.

**Note**: To prevent data loss or unexpected behaviour, the checkpoint delete should not be performed while other stateful checkpoint operations are in progress for the same National Insurance number.

post.description:
This endpoint enables you to reset the stateful data back to the checkpoint created in the sandbox environment.

A valid checkpoint ID must be provided.

When you restore the checkpoint, the modified date of the data will be updated to the restored date.

**Note**: To prevent data loss or unexpected behaviour, the checkpoint restore should not be performed while any other stateful or checkpoint operations are in progress for the same National Insurance number.
